technique_name: Generate new ideas for a vacation destination.
description: Some ideas for a vacation destination could include: exploring the mountains of Ecuador, white-water rafting through the Pacific Northwest of the United States, or even earning a scuba diving certification in the Caribbean. If you're interested in history, why not take a trip to ancient Rome to see some of the best-preserved sites of the Roman Empire? And if you're looking for something a bit more off the beaten path, why not explore some of the untouched areas in the African continent? Whatever
